staticPropertyReportScopeNote: This is the committed aggregate report as read; its figures do not establish provenance against the final mutated/restored source or an explicit VIP reassignment sequence.

mentalScenarios.scenario: Eight strangers with mixed local/remote/spectator surfaces and presence changes
mentalScenarios.observation: Fixed identities and own-teammate discovery stay readable. The two-team fixture has seat 6 in left despite connected=true, and seat 8 temporarily connected=false; roster distinguishes Left from Away. Spectator presentation contains Watching wording and no answer controls.
mentalScenarios.limit: A screenshot is not a live connection/accepted-input trace; retained-counter and denominator behavior belongs to separate recorded regressions.

mentalScenarios.scenario: VIP disappears during a live or paused game
mentalScenarios.observation: All captured nonpaused game phases have deadlines, so ordinary advancement has an automatic path. Ready VIP buttons are large and readable.
mentalScenarios.limit: No explicit ownership reassignment sequence is contained in this static inventory; pause recovery depends on SDK/runtime VIP handling.

mentalScenarios.scenario: Reveal is paused, then a teammate permanently leaves/reconnects
mentalScenarios.observation: The reveal fixture stores fixed answer/explanation/chart/standings durations. The mental flow should hold visible cuts at the pause instant, then shift every cut together when resumed; the same receipt/spectator roles remain appropriate.
mentalScenarios.limit: Paused reveal was not separately pictured in this inventory; the dedicated regression is the behavioral proof.

mentalScenarios.scenario: Correct shared final Room answer with opposite personal votes and a nonzero prior bank
mentalScenarios.observation: Final Room images do not print final gain, total or rank; personal vote is labeled separately from shared correctness and the footer says score after the podium. Partial podium pictures reveal no future team/name/score.
mentalScenarios.limit: The fixture is private state. Silent public view-field redaction is not observable from its PNG.

residualWeaknesses.title: VIP reassignment is outside the recorded phone fixture proof
residualWeaknesses.detail: Next/Show podium targets fit and every nonpaused phase has a finite deadline. The static fixtures and aggregate event list do not record losing the VIP and assigning its permissions to another phone, particularly while paused. No ownership-transfer failure is demonstrated.
residualWeaknesses.action: Use the separately owned SDK/runtime and regression evidence for this boundary; no game patch is justified by these PNGs.

residualWeaknesses.title: Paused reveal cuts cannot be reconstructed from the static paused pictures
residualWeaknesses.detail: The captured paused fixture is question, not reveal. Frozen answer/explanation/standings durations are present in the reveal fixture, but static aggregate traces do not independently show a leave-while-paused reveal and its uniformly shifted cuts. This is a limit of this review, not evidence that the separate cut-stability regression fails.
residualWeaknesses.action: Retain the dedicated cut-stability and final-source mutation results as the timing proof; no new UI change identified.

residualWeaknesses.title: Safe final Room pictures do not by themselves prove raw numeric view privacy
residualWeaknesses.detail: Final pictures correctly show the shared verdict, own vote and an em-dash score placeholder; spectators see only the answer/explanation. The authoritative private fixture has total 5851 and gain 1290 (prior bank 4561), but it is not a serialized public controller view. Raw delta/base/bonus omission must therefore be established by the separate final-room-privacy regression and semantic mutation, not inferred from hidden UI.
residualWeaknesses.action: Keep raw-view regression/mutation evidence separate from raster proof; no visual leak found.

residualWeaknesses.title: A single shared room displays an uninformative rank and empty podium tiers
residualWeaknesses.detail: The room is always in place 1; second/third plinths remain empty. They are understandable reuse of the standard quiz presentation and do not misstate another competitor, score or hidden winner.
residualWeaknesses.action: Optional simplification only; no material gain or required patch.

residualWeaknesses.title: Discovering teammates on staged phones requires one context switch
residualWeaknesses.detail: Opening the roster replaces the question/options; Back to question returns to them. The clock, full names and Left/Away distinctions remain clear, and the native open/close capture reports restoration. This is a small navigation cost of fitting every legal question and full names in390x844.
residualWeaknesses.action: Optional polish only; keeping the full legal content and no-scroll fit takes priority.

result.summary: No new material player-visible defect in this scoped review. Final behavioral/campaign status remains separately owned by root.
